owned_invariants: The task is edges, a list of pairs whose vertices are named 0 to n-1; c, one exact rational per edge; faces, a list of closed walks, each a list of [edge, sign] with the edge in range and sign 1 or -1; and optionally max_attempts, an exact integer from 1 to 5. A face that is not closed is refused before anything is asked.

Repair proposes phi, one exact rational per vertex listed by vertex name, in the WF20 loop. An attempt is accepted exactly when c is the coboundary of phi. The residual gives the size of the misfit and the edges that are off, never a value. A run repaired within the limit is certified as REPAIRED, and a repair that asks for a grant outside the structure is refused.

If repair ends without a certificate and without a request outside the structure, the host shows one receipt per failed attempt and asks for one boundary action. A receipt is the SHA-256 digest of the canonical JSON of the spec's digest, the attempt's number and its residual.
A boundary reply must take exactly one of refusal, lift and restart, or the run is refused as NOT_EXACTLY_ONE_ACTION.

Which action is admissible is fixed by c alone: refusal when some face sum of c is not zero, restart when c is a coboundary, lift when every face sum is zero and c is no coboundary. An action other than the admissible one fails the predicate action_matches_trichotomy.
A refusal names a face; it stands as the typed refusal UNCLOSED_COCHAIN only when the sum of c round that face is not zero.

A lift gives phi, k and an edge value h. It is certified as LIFT_AUTHORISED only when the defect of c is positive, every face sum of h is zero, and c equals the coboundary of phi plus k times h on every edge.

A restart gives a seed that holds exactly spec and receipts. The spec must be the task's edges, faces and c unchanged, and the receipts a nonempty list of receipts the host showed. A seed that keeps the edges and faces and changes c is refused as NEW_PROBLEM_NOT_REPAIR. The repair loop then runs once more on the seed, under the stages restart:attempt:<k> and the task's limit, and the run is certified as RESTART_REPAIRED only when that loop ends on a certificate.
boundaries: The three cases are told apart on the faces the task lists. A cycle the task does not list as a face is not examined for closure, so closed means closed on the listed faces.
A receipt is a digest of what the host itself computed. It shows that a seed carries what the host showed; it is not a signature.
A lift is checked as an identity between the values given. Nothing is claimed about what h means beyond its face sums.
The restart is one more bounded loop on the same values. Nothing here lets a run restart twice.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.

Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
